structuredContent.format: 441-bone MetaHuman armature GLB (skeleton animation, no mesh)
structuredContent.nextSteps: 3 clips are ready now - no tasks, no polling, no credits charged. Call get_asset with the returned assetPublicId (not the taskId), then present the selected signed URL as a clickable download link. This PINOC server is remote: download_asset cannot write to your disk, and a download-link request does not require a local file. They are all the same format, so this is said once for all of them: each is an armature-only clip - a skeleton with NO mesh, so it needs a character to drive. GLB opens in any glTF tool - Unity, Blender, Unreal, three.js - with nothing extra installed. Every asset can also be previewed and edited in the PINOC web app at https://viggle.ai/pinoc/app.
